checks.recorded: AF-15: "produce very few suckers and are highly resistant to diseases."
checks.page_wording: Plants are easily propagated by cuttings, produce very few suckers and are highly resistant to diseases. It also produces a good root system and throws virtually no suckers.
checks.note: GrownUps NZ says R. multiflora produces very few suckers and R. laxa throws virtually no suckers. The page does not mention R. canina; the R. canina point comes from another source.

contradictions: Page does not mention Rosa canina.
